metaDescription: Order custom moisture wicking embroidered patches for uniforms and gear. Durable, breathable, and perfect for active teams. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Moisture wicking embroidered patches combine the classic look of embroidery with performance fabric technology. These patches are designed to breathe and draw sweat away, making them ideal for sports uniforms, outdoor workwear, and fitness apparel. Unlike standard patches that can trap heat, moisture wicking options keep wearers dry and comfortable during physical activity. They are fully customizable with your logo or text and can be sewn or heat-sealed onto polyester, nylon, or other performance fabrics without compromising breathability.
heroAltText: Custom moisture wicking embroidered patches with breathable backing sewn onto a performance jersey
